proof_body:
by
  intro V _ _ _ G _
  rw [← G.card_connectedComponent_eq_finrank_ker_toLin'_lapMatrix, Fintype.card_eq_one_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨v⟩ := ‹Nonempty V›
    refine ⟨G.connectedComponentMk v, fun c => ?_⟩
    induction c using SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.ind with
    | _ w => exact SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.sound (h.preconnected w v)
  · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
    refine ⟨fun u v => ?_⟩
    have := (hc (G.connectedComponentMk u)).trans (hc (G.connectedComponentMk v)).symm
    exact SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.exact this
target_source: ∀ (V : Type*) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Nonempty V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj], G.Connected ↔ Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.ker (Matrix.toLin' (G.lapMatrix ℝ))) = 1
